name: axi_do_nothing_lap
description: Unit square, axis r = 0; Dirichlet on r = 1 and z = 0; the lap form's do-nothing condition sigma_lap n = 0 on z = 1 (and the other form's violated); swirl; variable mu; pressure determined.

conventions.coordinates: meridional (r, z), r >= 0; variables r, z in every spelling
conventions.components: (u_r, u_z, u_theta); grad_u[i][j] = d u_i / d (r, z)_j (meridional derivatives only)
conventions.sigma: 3x3, rows/columns (r, z, theta); sigma_sym = 2 mu eps - p I, sigma_lap = mu grad u - p I with grad u including the hoop entries (r,theta) = -u_t/r and (theta,theta) = u_r/r
conventions.f: -div sigma_form - gamma grad div u (= -div sigma_form for these divergence-free fields)
conventions.traction: g = sigma_form n, (sigma n)_i = sigma_ij n_j, n the outward unit normal (n_r, n_z, 0)
conventions.weights: volume integrals int (.) r dr dz, boundary integrals int (.) r ds; physical 3D values carry a further factor 2 pi

selfcheck.parity: u_r, u_t odd; u_z, p, mu even (symbolic)
selfcheck.forcing_routes: A == B at 6 random points, 60 digits, both forms, gamma 0 and 1
